spec.description: DataMigrationMappingRuleSpec defines the desired state of DataMigrationMappingRule

conditionalColumnSetValue.description: Optional. Rule to specify how the data contained in a column should be transformed (such as trimmed, rounded, etc) provided that the data meets certain criteria.

sourceNumericFilter.description: Optional. Optional filter on source column precision and scale. Used for fixed point numbers such as NUMERIC/NUMBER data types.

numericFilterOption.description: Required. Enum to set the option defining the datatypes numeric filter has to be applied to

sourceMaxPrecisionFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with precision smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMaxScaleFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with scale smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMinPrecisionFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with precision greater than or equal to this number.

sourceMinScaleFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with scale greater than or equal to this number.

sourceTextFilter.description: Optional. Optional filter on source column length. Used for text based data types like varchar.

sourceMaxLengthFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with length smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMinLengthFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with length greater than or equal to this number.

valueTransformation.description: Required. Description of data transformation during migration.

applyHash.description: Optional. Applies a hash function on the data

uuidFromBytes.description: Optional. Generate UUID from the data's byte array

assignMaxValue.description: Optional. Set to max_value - if integer or numeric, will use int.maxvalue, etc

assignMinValue.description: Optional. Set to min_value - if integer or numeric, will use int.minvalue, etc

assignSpecificValue.description: Optional. Set to a specific value (value is converted to fit the target data type)

value.description: Required. Specific value to be assigned

doubleComparison.description: Optional. Filter on relation between source value and compare value of type double.

value.description: Required. Double compare value to be used

valueComparison.description: Required. Relation between source value and compare value

intComparison.description: Optional. Filter on relation between source value and compare value of type integer.

value.description: Required. Integer compare value to be used

valueComparison.description: Required. Relation between source value and compare value

roundScale.description: Optional. Allows the data to change scale

scale.description: Required. Scale value to be used

valueList.description: Optional. Value is found in the specified list.

ignoreCase.description: Required. Whether to ignore case when filtering by values. Defaults to false

valuePresentList.description: Required. Indicates whether the filter matches rows with values that are present in the list or those with values not present in it.

values.description: Required. The list to be used to filter by

convertRowidColumn.description: Optional. Rule to specify how multiple tables should be converted with an additional rowid column.

onlyIfNoPrimaryKey.description: Required. Only work on tables without primary key defined

entityMove.description: Optional. Rule to specify how multiple entities should be relocated into a different schema.

entities.description: Optional. The rule should be applied to specific entities defined by their fully qualified names.

entityNameContains.description: Optional. The rule should be applied to entities whose non-qualified name contains the given string.

entityNamePrefix.description: Optional. The rule should be applied to entities whose non-qualified name starts with the given prefix.

entityNameSuffix.description: Optional. The rule should be applied to entities whose non-qualified name ends with the given suffix.

parentEntity.description: Optional. The rule should be applied to entities whose parent entity (fully qualified name) matches the given value. For example, if the rule applies to a table entity, the expected value should be a schema (schema). If the rule applies to a column or index entity, the expected value can be either a schema (schema) or a table (schema.table)

filterTableColumns.description: Optional. Rule to specify the list of columns to include or exclude from a table.

excludeColumns.description: Optional. List of columns to be excluded for a particular table.

includeColumns.description: Optional. List of columns to be included for a particular table.

multiColumnDataTypeChange.description: Optional. Rule to specify how multiple columns should be converted to a different data type.

overrideFractionalSecondsPrecision.description: Optional. Column fractional seconds precision - used only for timestamp based datatypes - if not specified and relevant uses the source column fractional seconds precision.

overrideLength.description: Optional. Column length - e.g. varchar (50) - if not specified and relevant uses the source column length.

overridePrecision.description: Optional. Column precision - when relevant - if not specified and relevant uses the source column precision.

overrideScale.description: Optional. Column scale - when relevant - if not specified and relevant uses the source column scale.

sourceDataTypeFilter.description: Required. Filter on source data type.

sourceNumericFilter.description: Optional. Filter for fixed point number data types such as NUMERIC/NUMBER.

numericFilterOption.description: Required. Enum to set the option defining the datatypes numeric filter has to be applied to

sourceMaxPrecisionFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with precision smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMaxScaleFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with scale smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMinPrecisionFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with precision greater than or equal to this number.

sourceMinScaleFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with scale greater than or equal to this number.

sourceTextFilter.description: Optional. Filter for text-based data types like varchar.

sourceMaxLengthFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with length smaller than or equal to this number.

sourceMinLengthFilter.description: Optional. The filter will match columns with length greater than or equal to this number.

multiEntityRename.description: Optional. Rule to specify how multiple entities should be renamed.

newNamePattern.description:
Optional. The pattern used to generate the new entity's name. This pattern
 must include the characters '{name}', which will be replaced with the name
 of the original entity. For example, the pattern 't_{name}' for an entity
 name jobs would be converted to 't_jobs'.

 If unspecified, the default value for this field is '{name}'

sourceNameTransformation.description: Optional. Additional transformation that can be done on the source entity name before it is being used by the new_name_pattern, for example lower case. If no transformation is desired, use NO_TRANSFORMATION

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The DataMigrationMappingRule name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

ruleOrder.description: Required. The order in which the rule is applied. Lower order rules are applied before higher value rules so they may end up being overridden.

setTablePrimaryKey.description: Optional. Rule to specify the primary key for a table

primaryKey.description: Optional. Name for the primary key

primaryKeyColumns.description: Required. List of column names for the primary key

singleColumnChange.description: Optional. Rule to specify how a single column is converted.

array.description: Optional. Is the column of array type.

arrayLength.description: Optional. The length of the array, only relevant if the column type is an array.

charset.description: Optional. Charset override - instead of table level charset.

collation.description: Optional. Collation override - instead of table level collation.

comment.description: Optional. Comment associated with the column.

fractionalSecondsPrecision.description: Optional. Column fractional seconds precision - e.g. 2 as in timestamp (2) - when relevant.

length.description: Optional. Column length - e.g. 50 as in varchar (50) - when relevant.

precision.description: Optional. Column precision - e.g. 8 as in double (8,2) - when relevant.

scale.description: Optional. Column scale - e.g. 2 as in double (8,2) - when relevant.

setValues.description: Optional. Specifies the list of values allowed in the column.

udt.description: Optional. Is the column a UDT (User-defined Type).

singleEntityRename.description: Optional. Rule to specify how a single entity should be renamed.

newName.description: Required. The new name of the destination entity

singlePackageChange.description: Optional. Rule to specify how a single package is converted.

packageBody.description: Optional. Sql code for package body

packageDescription.description: Optional. Sql code for package description

sourceSQLChange.description: Optional. Rule to change the sql code for an entity, for example, function, procedure.

sqlCode.description: Required. Sql code for source (stored procedure, function, trigger or view)
